Login_Subtitle: Sign in through your browser to securely connect your Spotify library using PKCE.
Login_Step3: 3. Paste the Client ID from the app's settings:
Main_SessionExpired: Your Spotify session has expired. Please sign in again.
Main_InvalidClientId: A Client ID is 32 hexadecimal characters (0–9, a–f). Copy it from Spotify Developer Dashboard → your app → Settings.
Auth_NoClientId: Spotify Client ID isn't set. Enter it on the sign-in screen.
Auth_Timeout: Sign-in in the browser wasn't completed.
Auth_PageSuccessText: You can close this tab and return to the app.
Auth_PageFailText: Return to the app and try again.
Api_NoPlaylistId: Spotify didn't return the ID of the new playlist.
Search_Placeholder: What do you want to play?
Playlist_ErrDevMode: Spotify doesn't give apps in development mode the tracks of other people's playlists (a Web API restriction since February 2026). You can still play the whole playlist with the ▶ button.
Playlist_Err403: Spotify denied access to this playlist (403). Apps in development mode can only access your own playlists and ones you collaborate on.
Settings_LanguageDesc: The language of the app's interface
Settings_RestartMessage: The new language will be used after the app restarts.
Backdrop_Mica_Desc: Subtly tinted by your wallpaper. Recommended.
Backdrop_MicaAlt_Desc: Mica with a stronger wallpaper tint.
Backdrop_Acrylic_Desc: Translucent blur of what's behind the window.
Settings_ThemeDesc: Light, dark or as in Windows
Support_NoMica: Mica requires Windows 11, so a solid background is used instead.
Support_NoAcrylic: Acrylic isn't available on this system, so a solid background is used instead.
Support_NoBackdrops: System materials aren't available on this system, so a solid background is used.
Settings_BackgroundDesc: The official client plays the audio. It starts hidden and plays on this PC.
Settings_ClientMissingMessage: Without it, music can't play on this PC — you can only control other devices. Install it from Microsoft Store or spotify.com.
Settings_ClientIdDesc: Sign out and enter a different Client ID
Settings_BetaDesc: New features sooner, but bugs are possible
Update_DownloadingRestart: Downloading update… {0:0}%. The app will restart after installation.
Update_Ready: Installation takes less than a minute, and the app restarts by itself.
UpdErr_NotFound: GitHub releases are unavailable (the repository is private or doesn't exist).
UpdErr_HashMismatch: The checksum of the downloaded installer didn't match, so the update was cancelled.
UpdErr_HashCorrupt: The checksum file in the release is damaged, so the update was cancelled.
UpdErr_NoInternet: No internet connection, or GitHub is unavailable.
UpdErr_Timeout: GitHub didn't respond in time. Check your internet connection.
Wrapped_Subtitle: What you listened to most, based on Spotify's statistics
Wrapped_NoGenresHint: Spotify didn't list genres for your artists, so there's no genre ranking.
Wrapped_ReloginMessage: My Summary needs new Spotify permissions: listening statistics and creating playlists. Sign in again and confirm access — your library and settings are kept.
Wrapped_EmptyMessage: Spotify hasn't collected statistics for “{0}” yet. Listen to more music or choose a longer period.
Wrapped_PlaylistDescription: Your top {0} tracks for “{1}”. Made with Fluent Spotify.
Wrapped_SavedMessage: “{0}” — {1}. It's private and already in your library.
Wrapped_Err403: Spotify rejected the request (403). If the app is in development mode, make sure your account is added under User Management in Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Wrapped_Err429: Too many requests to Spotify. Wait a minute and click “Refresh”.
Wrapped_ErrOffline: No connection to Spotify. Check your internet connection and try again.
